title: Check effective vLLM AOT routing when isolating compilation caches
applies_when: A vLLM compiler reproduction disables compilation caching to obtain a fresh run, or passes use_aot_compile=True and intends to validate the normal AOT/mega-artifact path.
lesson: In the inspected vLLM revision, VLLM_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 changes the default VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE to false; this also changes the default VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT to false. Passing VllmBackend(use_aot_compile=True) alone does not override those environment defaults. Check the effective environment flags and selected adapter, and observe backend.use_mega_artifact before claiming AOT coverage. If cold isolation is the objective, a fresh task-private cache directory can preserve the intended cache/AOT configuration. Distinguish successful graph execution, actual AOT selection, artifact generation/serialization and warm-cache reload: success at one does not establish the others.
avoid_when: Explicit VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE or VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT overrides can change these defaults; disabling caching does not unconditionally prohibit AOT. Other vLLM/Torch revisions or backends may route differently. A non-AOT test can be a useful deliberate diagnostic, but cannot be relabeled as default AOT, serving-model, accelerator, performance or complete-cache qualification. Do not alter shared cache settings or remove isolation to force a pass.

evidence.note: Pinned use_aot_compile and use_mega_aot_artifact functions show the cache-disable-dependent defaults and the separate explicit environment overrides. This supports the configuration mechanism, not a universal failure claim.

VllmBackend combines the constructor's use_aot_compile with the effective mega-artifact flag; the constructor argument alone is insufficient. Read the actual selected version rather than inferring execution from the requested argument.

The standalone adapter enables Torch's aot parameter only when both its requested flag and effective VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT are true. This is route-selection evidence, not proof an artifact was successfully saved or reloaded.
